gate: Hunger for the next experience runs through this code like weather. The drive is to step into what has not been lived yet, to feel the new thing in the body, to find out what it costs and what it teaches. It carries an emotional charge that rides high then drops low, a wave that does not flatten out on command. Most people mistake this drive for restlessness, or worse, for someone who cannot commit. The restlessness reading misses what is happening. The code is not running from anything. It is running toward the experience it has not yet had, because that is how it gathers what it knows. The misread of crisis is to treat the high and low as a personality fault, something to medicate or smooth. The crisis is the mechanism. The wave is how this code learns.
centre_field: Feeling is the engine here, and the engine is also the sensor, the only place in the body-map that drives action and reads it at the same time. That doubling is the whole teaching. Feelings here are not a soft layer added on top, they are a force that drives action and at the same time a sense that reads what is happening. Crisis sits inside that doubling. It rides the wave this centre runs, climbing into appetite for a new experience and crashing into doubt about whether what was reached for can actually be met. The misread is to treat the wave as a malfunction, to chase the high and flee the low. The teaching is patience. Clarity does not arrive at the peak or in the trough. It arrives once the wave levels and the body knows, without strain, what the next experience is actually for.
channel: A code that lives in the belly does not, on its own, get said out loud. The hunger gathers experience after experience, but the wisdom in those experiences stays trapped in the body if it has no way to cross into speech. What this gate reaches toward is the gate of change, the partner that lives in the throat and turns lived experience into something a listener can actually receive. Together they form the channel of transitoriness, the collective current that converts a life of varied experience into stories the rest of us can use. Alone, the hunger keeps eating and the experiences pile up untold. Joined, the wave finds a voice and the crisis finds a meaning beyond itself. The reach is what saves the code from being only appetite.
